**# Disc Preview**

A Fabric mod that lets you preview Minecraft music discs by hovering over them in inventories.

**## Features**
- 🎵 Music disc preview on hover
- ⏱ 0.75 second hover delay
- 🌊 Smooth fade in/out
- 🔊 Uses the Records sound volume
- 📦 Only works inside inventories
- ⚙️ On/Off Switch
- 🎶 Volume Slider
- 💿 Works with Custom Music Discs like [More Music Discs](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-music-discs) by [MarsThePlanet](https://modrinth.com/user/MarsThePlanet).

**## Requirements**

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config

**## Optional**
- ModMenu
